essence: The teacher is honored as the giver of knowledge by the wise Kṛṣṇānanda.
The relationship concerns both the teacher and the disciple.
The figure is formally called the teacher.
The best teacher is a truth-speaking, ascetic brāhmaṇa householder.
Violation leads to terrible hell and fruitless worship.
